# ScienceAlert

> ScienceAlert delivers breaking science news and breakthroughs across space, health, environment, technology, physics, nature, and human science with rigorous fact-checking and expert analysis.

ScienceAlert is a leading science journalism platform covering the latest research discoveries and scientific developments. The site organizes content into eight major topic areas (Space, Health, Environment, Humans, Tech, Nature, Physics, and Society) alongside opinion pieces, explainers, and editorial resources.

## Key Topics

- science-news

## Core Science News Sections

- [ScienceAlert Homepage](https://www.sciencealert.com): ScienceAlert homepage with latest science news across health, space, nature, tech
- [Space](https://www.sciencealert.com/space): Space news section covering NASA, Mars exploration, black holes, and astronomy
- [Health](https://www.sciencealert.com/health): Health section featuring medical research, pharmaceuticals, and wellness news
- [Environment](https://www.sciencealert.com/environment): Environment section covering climate change, glaciers, and extreme weather
- [Humans](https://www.sciencealert.com/humans): Human science section on evolution, genetics, archaeology, and brain research
- [Tech](https://www.sciencealert.com/tech): Technology section featuring AI, quantum computing, and innovation breakthroughs
- [Nature](https://www.sciencealert.com/nature): Nature section with wildlife discoveries, paleontology, and animal behavior
- [Physics](https://www.sciencealert.com/physics): Physics section covering quantum mechanics, CERN, and particle physics research

## Analysis & Commentary

- [Society](https://www.sciencealert.com/society): Science and society section tackling denialism, fact-checking, and culture
- [Opinion](https://www.sciencealert.com/opinion): Opinion and commentary section with expert analysis on science and ethics
- [Explainer](https://www.sciencealert.com/explainer): Science explainer section providing background on fundamentals and trends

## Featured Articles

- [New Caffeine Alternative Promises No Jitters or Crash. Here's The Evidence.](https://www.sciencealert.com/new-caffeine-alternative-promises-no-jitters-or-crash-heres-the-evidence): Article on Paraxanthine as caffeine alternative with scientific evidence
- [Dick Van Dyke Credits His Longevity to One Habit, And Science Supports It](https://www.sciencealert.com/dick-van-dyke-credits-his-longevity-to-one-habit-and-science-supports-it): Article on longevity and stress management with health science research
